title: Scene presets
calm_flow_desc: Low-energy ambient, chill and downtempo music for quiet focus.
kinetic_pulse_desc: Rhythm-forward electronic music with movement, momentum and clear pulse.
cosmic_drift_desc: Trance, progressive and synth-led music with a spacious, steady flow.
bass_impact_desc: Bass-heavy and high-impact music built around weight, drops and rough texture.
browse_desc: Four explainable listening contexts maintained by the instance administrator. Tracks with uncertain or conflicting evidence stay outside these collections until reviewed.
